description.value: Royal Canadian Legion Branch 2 is a veterans' social club and pub on Sixth Street in New Westminster, part of the BC/Yukon Command's network of over 145 branches across British Columbia and the Yukon. Founded by and for veterans, the Legion supports current and former Canadian Armed Forces and RCMP members and their families through community gathering space and veteran advocacy services. The venue is non-smoking and features both indoor and outdoor seating.
